title: Add first-class susi acp CLI stdio/discovery subcommand and 5th-pillar ACP black-box conformance checks
goal: Close two production gaps on Susi Core's 5th Open-Core Pillar (ACP, Mandates 62, 74, 75): (1) expose first-class `susi acp`, `susi acp serve`, and `susi acp discover [--json]` CLI subcommands with zero-banner newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio transport (<20ms startup) and port-offset-aware `susi-acp-discovery/v1` output, and (2) add black-box ACP discovery, bearer-auth enforcement (`/acp`, `/acp/stream`), JSON-RPC session lifecycle (`acp.rpc`), and opt-in `susi acp serve` stdio (`acp.stdio`) conformance checks to `susi-conformance`.

results.tests: susi-cli-defs lib 2 passed, susi-conformance lib 24 passed + bin 5 passed, susi lib 9 passed + bin 142 passed, architecture_tests 49 passed, lean_core_ceilings 2 passed, orphan_sources 3 passed, thin_client_invariant 5 passed, task_records 3 passed, clippy --all-targets 0 warnings

reuse.reason: Reused existing susi_core::acp::{AcpServer, AcpStdioTransport, AcpDiscoveryDocument, AcpTurnExecutor}, mirrored susi mcp pre-boot zero-banner CLI dispatch, and extended susi_conformance's existing HTTP and stdio child-process harness with zero new dependencies.
reuse.searched: Searched intellibitz/susi crates/susi-core/src/acp.rs, crates/susi-gawd-a2a/src/{executor.rs,lib.rs}, crates/susi-cli-defs/src/{lib.rs,mcp.rs}, src/cli/{mcp_cli.rs,control_plane_cli.rs,defs.rs}, crates/susi-conformance/src/lib.rs, intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps ACP bridge/inspector/studio packs, Apache-2.0 ACP crates, and the locked Cargo dependency graph; Susi Core already implements AcpServer, AcpStdioTransport, AcpDiscoveryDocument, and susi-conformance's HTTP + stdio harness.
reuse.source: intellibitz/susi crates/susi-core/src/acp.rs, crates/susi-gawd-a2a/src/executor.rs, crates/susi-cli-defs/src/mcp.rs, src/cli/mcp_cli.rs, crates/susi-conformance/src/lib.rs
